candidate_evidence.title: [Wayland/Ozone] Per-window input freeze — events received on socket but not dispatched to affected window
candidate_evidence.excerpt: ### Description When running Electron (via VSCode) on native Wayland with the COSMIC compositor, individual windows intermittently and permanently lose all mouse and keyboard input. The window continues to render normally — buffer updates are composited, animations play, terminal output scrolls — but the window accepts zero input. No recovery is possible; the affected window must be closed. Other
